title: Army composition
caption: Half-stack templates by military tech, which unit pips to pick, and the techs that give a big jump. Raven1945's Unit Composition Guide v1.0, made for 1.34.
alt: Raven1945's army chart. Half-stack templates by military tech: tech 0, 15 width, 7 infantry 1 cavalry 0 artillery, 8 total. Tech 16, 30 width, 13 infantry 2 cavalry 15 artillery. Tech 26, 40 width, 16 infantry 4 cavalry 20 artillery. Big techs: 4 (1453), 5 (1466), 6 (1479), 7 (1492), 9 (1518), 12 (1557), 15 (1596), 16 (1609), 19 (1648), 26 (1745). Prioritise offensive shock and morale for early infantry, defensive fire and morale once enemies field artillery.

title: Naval templates
caption: Fleet sizes by year for an all-purpose fleet, an inland sea fleet and an oceanic fleet. Raven45's Naval Guide v0.2.
alt: Raven45's naval chart. All-purpose fleet: 1420, 4 heavies 14 galleys; 1492, 6 and 18; 1557, 9 and 27; 1635, 10 and 32; 1687, 12 and 32; 1715, 13 and 39. Inland sea fleet: 1420, 2 heavies 22 galleys up to 1715, 6 heavies 62 galleys. Oceanic fleet: 1420, 9 heavies up to 1715, 27 heavies, galleys optional. Use the rest of the naval force limit for light ships and transports.
